snippet.title: ARSoccer - augmented reality soccer for the iPhone
snippet.description:
Get the app: http://bit.ly/ARSoccer

The amazing new ARSoccer app lets you play a virtual juggling game using your iPhone's camera. 

Works on 3G, 3GS, and 4G
